# Nutshell CRM | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning in one sentence | The easy-to-use CRM for small and medium-sized B2B sales and marketing teams containing forms, land pages, chats and AI results quotas. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competition Boundaries | High-level privileges, SQL read-only and unlimited pipelines require Enterprise; marketing contacts, text messages, AI exits and quote modules increase costs. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | High-level privileges, SQL read-only and unlimited pipelines require Enterprise; marketing contacts, text messages, AI exits and quote modules increase costs. |
